address: 38 Mu 7, Phra Khao, Bang Ban, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13250, Thailand
bio: The old mill that houses this riverside restaurant is over 130 years old and provides a unique vintage atmosphere to diners seeking a memorable experience. Delicate titbits such as Toong Thong and the flower-like Chor Muang make delightful starters, before moving on to main courses including the fabulous fried snakehead fish with herbs and deep-fried shrimp with tamarind sauce. They also offer a river tour package along the Noi, which culminates in dining at the restaurant. Booking is essential....
